abstract: Maintains active suppression system compliance, egress clearance durations, and safety buffer floor requirements
system_message:
You are Fire and life safety inspector (FLS). The Fire and life safety inspector (FLS) maintains operational fire suppression compliance, emergency egress durations, and dedicated safety buffer areas, alongside hydrant delivery diagnostics across candidate symposium venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains active suppression system compliance, egress clearance durations, and safety buffer floor requirements（FIRE）
information_points.content:
FLS-FIRE-8GM：At Cascade Meadow Exhibition Park, operational fire suppression is certified across the entire interior exhibition and assembly structure, and the full-capacity emergency evacuation clearance time is 8 min. The required dedicated safety buffer area reserving unencumbered emergency egress corridors across the combined halls totals 900 m2.
FLS-FIRE-H24：At Pacific Horizon Convention Centre, operational fire suppression is certified across the entire interior exhibition and assembly structure, while the measured emergency evacuation clearance time for full-capacity assembly evacuation is 14 min. The dedicated safety buffer area excluded from exhibition floor space is 400 m2.
FLS-FIRE-GA2：At Starlight Bay Events Complex, operational fire suppression is certified for the interior structure, and the emergency evacuation clearance time measured during drill testing is 8 min. A dedicated safety buffer area of 900 m2 is reserved for unencumbered corridor and emergency exit staging.

information_points.title: Hydrant pressure diagnostics（SPRINK）
information_points.content:
FLS-SPRINK-SU8：For Cascade Meadow Exhibition Park, hydrostatic testing on the primary riser assembly at the main entrance records a standpipe delivery pressure of 500 kPa.
FLS-SPRINK-DDB：For Pacific Horizon Convention Centre, quarterly testing of the primary riser assembly records a standpipe delivery pressure of 550 kPa.
FLS-SPRINK-2A0：For Starlight Bay Events Complex, hydrostatic testing indicates a standpipe delivery pressure of 450 kPa at the primary entrance riser assembly.
